skills.name: Discussing the management of people, time and money

note.text: Planning assigns tasks, orders activities and checks resources. Delegation gives a suitable task to someone with a clear understanding of it; coordination helps related tasks fit together. A deadline states when work is due. A budget compares expected resources with planned uses. None guarantees success without checking progress. This lesson uses a fictional club rather than advising on a real household's finances or giving pupils authority over others.

sections.heading: Understand the ideas
sections.text: Planning assigns tasks, orders activities and checks resources. Delegation gives a suitable task to someone with a clear understanding of it; coordination helps related tasks fit together. A deadline states when work is due. A budget compares expected resources with planned uses. None guarantees success without checking progress. This lesson uses a fictional club rather than advising on a real household's finances or giving pupils authority over others.

sections.heading: Apply the ideas locally
sections.text: Original dialogue: A club plans an exhibition. Bih asks who will label the displays, while Ayuk checks that labels are ready before visitors arrive. Members compare expected contributions with planned material costs. They reserve time to review progress and adjust a task if someone needs help. Giving orders without checking understanding would not provide the same coordination.

sections.heading: Reason and check
sections.text: Identify the goal, tasks, responsible people, timing and resources. Ask a clear question when an instruction is uncertain. Explain how one task depends on another. A plan should be reviewed when circumstances change rather than treated as a guarantee.
